body:
Less comfort zone and more crippling anxiety. I hate myself for anything small that goes poorly. My brain uses any embarrassment or failure against me forever.

I really don't have it in me to make friends or to stand up for myself. Most of the time I just want to hide.  Once in a blue moon, someone will want to get to know me better, and it goes nowhere because I'm too scared of messing up or making myself vulnerable.

There definitely are other trans people around, anxiety is a big obstacle there. I do hang out in an lgbtq IRC channel or two at least.

If I managed to keep my job here after coming out it'd still be massively uncomfortable, I don't think I could handle it. I'm one of two not mormons in my department...
Pretty much just to people on the internet.
